data.description: Rare Trophy Penthouse |Ultra-High Floor| Sea Views
data.long_description:
A truly rare opportunity to acquire one of the most impressive trophy residences in Dubai Marina.

Occupying an exceptional position within the iconic twisted Cayan Tower, this ultra-high-floor penthouse spans 5,294 sq ft and commands sweeping panoramic views across Dubai Marina, the Arabian Gulf, Palm Jumeirah, and the city skyline.

Designed for those who value privacy, scale, and exclusivity, this fully upgraded residence offers expansive living spaces, floor-to-ceiling windows, and ever-changing views from sunrise to sunset.

Property Highlights:

* Ultra-high-floor penthouse in the iconic Cayan Tower
* 5,294 sq ft of refined living space
* Uninterrupted Marina, sea, and skyline views
* Expansive open-plan living and dining areas
* Floor-to-ceiling glass throughout
* Four spacious en-suite bedrooms
* Private study/home office
* Walk-in wardrobes and generous storage
* Multiple private balconies
* Fully upgraded and tastefully furnished
* Vacant and ready for immediate occupancy

Opportunities to secure a residence of this scale and elevation within Dubai Marina are exceptionally limited. Combining world-renowned architecture, commanding views, and substantial living space, this penthouse represents a unique offering for discerning end-users and investors seeking a landmark address.

This is more than a home. It is a statement residence in one of Dubai’s most recognised towers.

Private viewings are available strictly by appointment.
